description: Estimation de la consommation domestique moyenne d'eau de distribution de WalStat is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IWEPS WalStat. L’indicateur donne la consommation d'eau de distribution (en m3 par an) des 'petits consommateurs' (c’est-à-dire des consommateurs dont le compteur d'eau débite moins de 250 m3/an). Cela inclut en général les ménages privés et exclut les entreprises. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Administration and Public Services, Farming, Environment. Its keywords are environnement, consommation, eau, statistiques. The portal shows 263 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons - CC0 (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
